svg.text: • Every idea and every constant move loses on average, between -0.05 and -0.07 among those with 5 or more turns. The typical edit makes the program

text.font-family: Open Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: worse, and the kept ones typically gain about +0.02.

text.font-family: Open Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
